_: Regions Unexplored's muds wear as dirt, as the families' table has mud: they are built as the game's own mud is, short of their cell with mud's sound, which the rules refuse. Its ash and volcanic ash wear as sand: they fall as sand does with gravel's sound, which one build of the mod makes a sand of and another a gravel, so they are named to be the same on every edition and loader. Argillite and chalk, the rock under its own turfs, wear as stone: neither name carries a word the rules read as rock. The rest of the mod is detection's where detection places it: its other grass blocks and turfs wear as grass and its dirts and podzols as dirt by their sounds, its paths and farmland are refused by their words, and its leaves and webbing are leaves by detection.

From All the Mods 10's census (W4 R9, judged 2026-11-12), as 1.20.1's file has them from Prominence's. Grass: the alpha grass block, which the rules make dirt by its ground material, and the argillite and chalk grass blocks, the turfs over that rock, on materials the rules do not read as turf. Nether: the brimsprout, cobalt and glistering nyliums, mycotoxic moss and cobalt obsidian are the Nether's own ground with no nether word. Stone: the ash vent is the rock of its volcanic ground, with no stone word. Named one by one, only the blocks that census judged; its deepslate grass block was not judged by it, nor by any edition's census, and is left to the rules.

Judged in the same census in W4 R13 (2026-11-13), so the editions match: the stone grass block, a turf judged by its living top, and prismoss and deepslate prismoss, a living moss top as the moss block is, grass, as 1.20.1's census and 26.1.2's ruled them; the viridescent and deepslate viridescent nyliums, nylium ground, nether by what they are wherever they lie, as 26.1.2's census ruled them both and 1.20.1's the deepslate one. All are on a material no rule reads.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.21.1 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was.
